Interface SubscriberConfig<T>

Type Parameters:
T - the type of values delivered to the subscriber
All Known Implementing Classes:
DefaultSubscriberBuilder
public interface SubscriberConfig<T>
Fluent configuration interface for registering lifecycle handlers on a Subscriber. An instance of this interface is passed as a customizer lambda to a primitive's subscribe method: 
atom.subscribe(snapshot, cfg -> cfg
    .onNext(snap -> process(snap))
    .onExpired(() -> reconnect())
    .onDeleted(() -> cleanup())
    .onError(err -> log.error("subscription error", err)));

Alternatively, when a direct Subscriber lambda is sufficient: 

atom.subscribe(snapshot, snap -> process(snap));

This interface deliberately exposes no build() method and no static factories — materializing a Subscriber from the configured handlers is an implementation detail.
